release_name: Live TV v5.4.0 (Build 67) — 1080p FHD Default Start & Microservices Core
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📺 1080p FHD Default Playback: Every live broadcast stream now starts directly in pristine 1080p FHD resolution (or maximum variant resolution available) by default across HLS and DASH.
⚡ Adaptive Buffer & Cap Bypass: Disabled viewport size quality capping (capLevelToPlayerSize=false) to ensure instant high-bitrate delivery without initial low-res warmup delay.
⚙️ Persistent Quality Preference: Selecting quality options in the Playback Settings modal now reliably persists across all channels and reboots.
🏗️ 3-Platform Microservices Architecture: Fully decoupled modular architecture across macOS Native, Android Native, and Web Core.
🏎️ Enterprise Sports Multi-Server CDN: Verified Dorna MotoGP Official World Feed, FanCode, Willow Sports, SPOTV 2, Sky Sports, and beIN Sports with instant automatic failover.
